title: High-throughput generation of midbrain dopaminergic neuron organoids from reporter human pluripotent stem cells
author: Sarrafha, Parfitt, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagent stock solutions
steps.instruction: Aliquot and store the following stock solutions at –20 °C: LDN193189 10 mM in ddH₂O; SB431542 50 mM in DMSO; Purmorphamine 10 mM in DMSO; SAG 10 mM in DMSO; CHIR99021 15 mM in DMSO; BDNF 20 µg/mL in 0.1 % BSA/PBS; GDNF 20 µg/mL in 0.1 % BSA/PBS; Ascorbic Acid 40 mM in ddH₂O; DAPT 50 mM in DMSO; dcAMP 20 mM in ddH₂O. Keep total DMSO in culture ≤0.1 % and use 1.5 µM CHIR99021 for the 3‑D protocol as recommended.

steps.title: Prepare differentiation media formulations
steps.instruction: Make fresh media every 2 days, store at 4 °C ≤1 week. Prepare the following formulations (all in DMEM/F‑12 + Glutamax, 1× B‑27 minus vitamin A, 1× N‑2):

substeps.instruction: D0‑1 (Patterning): add 100 nM LDN193189 and 10 µM SB431542.
D2‑3 (Patterning): add 100 nM LDN193189, 10 µM SB431542, 2 µM Purmorphamine, 1 µM SAG.
D4‑7 (Patterning): same as D2‑3 plus 1.5 µM CHIR99021.
D8‑11 (Patterning): 100 nM LDN193189, 1.5 µM CHIR99021 (no SB, Purmorphamine, SAG).
D12‑21 (Terminal): 20 ng/mL BDNF, 20 ng/mL GDNF, 0.2 mM Ascorbic Acid, 10 µM DAPT, 0.1 mM dcAMP.
D22‑35 (Terminal): 10 ng/mL BDNF, 10 ng/mL GDNF, 0.2 mM Ascorbic Acid, 10 µM DAPT, 0.1 mM dcAMP.
D36+ (Terminal): 10 ng/mL BDNF, 10 ng/mL GDNF, 0.2 mM Ascorbic Acid (no DAPT or dcAMP).

steps.title: Coat 10‑cm dishes with Geltrex
steps.instruction: Add 8 mL Geltrex solution to each 10‑cm dish, incubate in a 37 °C CO₂ incubator for ≥1 h. Coat one extra dish for nucleofection control.

steps.title: Wash confluent hPSCs with PBS
steps.instruction: Aspirate StemFlex medium from 70‑80 % confluent hPSCs in a 10‑cm dish and wash with 8 mL PBS to remove debris.

steps.title: Detach cells using Accutase
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL fresh Accutase to the dish, incubate at 20‑25 °C for 5 min with occasional gentle shaking. No neutralization needed.

steps.title: Prepare wash buffer in tube
steps.instruction: In a 15‑mL conical tube, add 10 mL hPSC wash buffer (see key resources).

steps.title: Transfer cells to tube and mix
steps.instruction: Gently pipette the detached cells 3‑5 times with a 5‑mL pipette, transfer to the 15‑mL tube, and mix 3‑5 times.

steps.title: Count cells and allocate for nucleofection
steps.instruction: Take a small aliquot for Trypan Blue counting. Collect 2 × 10⁶ cells for the nucleofection reaction and an additional 2 × 10⁶ cells for the nucleofection control.

steps.title: Centrifuge cells
steps.instruction: Spin the cell suspension at 300 × g for 3 min.

steps.title: Assemble DNA‑nucleofection mixtures
steps.instruction: In a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube combine for the targeting reaction: 5 µg TH‑TdTomato vector, 1 µg CRISPR 1, 1 µg CRISPR 2, and 100 µL nucleofection mix. For the control tube combine: 5 µg pmaxGFP vector and 100 µL nucleofection mix.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in nucleofection mix
steps.instruction: Aspirate the supernatant from the 15‑mL tube and gently resuspend the cell pellet in the DNA‑nucleofection mixture using a 200‑µL pipette tip.

steps.title: Load cells into cuvette on ice
steps.instruction: Transfer the cell‑DNA suspension to a nucleofection cuvette, place the cuvette on ice.

steps.title: Perform nucleofection (Program Ca137)
steps.instruction: Run the 4D‑Nucleofector Core Unit with program Ca137. After the pulse, keep the cuvette on ice.

steps.title: Add StemFlex + Thiazovivin to dishes
steps.instruction: Remove Geltrex solution from the coated 10‑cm dishes and add 8 mL pre‑warmed (37 °C) StemFlex medium supplemented with 2 µM Thiazovivin. No wash step is required.

steps.title: Plate nucleofected cells
steps.instruction: Gently pipette the cells from the cuvette into the prepared dishes.

steps.title: Incubate plates in humidified incubator
steps.instruction: Place the dishes in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ humidified incubator.

steps.title: Day 1: Inspect cells, no media change
steps.instruction: Under a tissue‑culture microscope verify cell health and GFP expression in the control; do not change media.

steps.title: Day 2: Start puromycin selection
steps.instruction: Add puromycin to StemFlex medium to a final concentration of 1 µg/mL and change media daily for 48 h. Do not add Thiazovivin.

steps.title: Day 4: Replace media without puromycin
steps.instruction: Refresh the dishes with fresh StemFlex medium lacking puromycin.

steps.title: Refresh media every other day until colonies
steps.instruction: Change media every other day until hPSC colonies become visible (≈5‑7 days).

steps.title: Pool colonies and passage with Accutase
steps.instruction: Collect all visible colonies, treat with Accutase, triturate with a 1‑mL pipette tip to obtain a single‑cell suspension (extend incubation if needed).

steps.title: Split cells: Cre‑GFP nucleofection and backup freeze
steps.instruction: Divide the cell suspension: use half for Cre‑GFP nucleofection; freeze the other half into two or more cryovials as backup (avoid repeated freeze‑thaw cycles).

steps.title: Repeat nucleofection with Cre‑GFP vector
steps.instruction: Perform a second nucleofection using 5 µg Cre‑GFP plasmid (include a non‑nucleofected negative control and a GFP nucleofection control for FACS gating).

steps.title: Optional: Perform lipofection transfection
steps.instruction: If preferred, use Lipofectamine Stem as follows:

substeps.instruction: i. Plate hPSCs in a 6‑well plate at 70‑80 % confluency in StemFlex + 2 µM Thiazovivin 1 h before transfection.
ii. Prepare two tubes per well: 1 mL Opti‑MEM + 4 µL Lipofectamine; 1 mL Opti‑MEM + 4 µg targeting vector + 1 µg CRISPR 1 + 1 µg CRISPR 2.
iii. Combine the tubes, incubate 20‑25 °C for 10 min.
iv. Replace StemFlex medium with the transfection mix, incubate 2 h at 37 °C.
v. Change to fresh StemFlex medium.
vi. For Cre‑GFP transfection, use 5 µg plasmid per reaction and proceed to FACS the next day.

steps.title: Day 1 post‑Cre: Prepare cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Allow Cre‑GFP expression to peak (~16 h); cells can be sorted up to 48 h post‑nucleofection.

steps.title: FACS sort GFP+ cells and plate
steps.instruction: Sort 5,000‑10,000 GFP⁺ cells per Geltrex‑coated 10‑cm dish containing 8 mL pre‑warmed StemFlex stock.

steps.title: Day 3: Replace media without additives
steps.instruction: Refresh plates with StemFlex medium lacking Thiazovivin and Pen/Strep.

steps.title: Change media every other day to grow colonies
steps.instruction: Continue changing media every other day until colonies are clearly visible (7‑10 days).

steps.title: Day of picking: Refresh media to remove debris
steps.instruction: Replace media with StemFlex stock to clear debris before colony picking.

steps.title: Prepare uncoated and Geltrex‑coated 12‑well plates
steps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL StemFlex stock per well to uncoated 12‑well plates. Coat a matching set of 12‑well plates with Geltrex, remove Geltrex immediately before plating colonies.

steps.title: Pick colonies and transfer to coated wells
steps.instruction: Under a sterile microscope, scrape each colony with a 200‑µL tip (set to 200 µL), transfer to an uncoated well, triturate with a fresh 1‑mL tip, then move the suspension to a Geltrex‑coated well. Store plates in the incubator.

steps.title: Collect colony cells for gDNA extraction
steps.instruction: Using the same tip, collect 100‑200 µL of each colony into PCR strips, centrifuge 300 × g for 3 min, then resuspend pellets in 40‑60 µL of 1 mL DirectPCR Lysis Reagent + 25 µL Proteinase K (follow manufacturer’s protocol).

steps.title: Genotype colonies by touchdown PCR
steps.instruction: Run three PCR reactions (5′, 3′, 5′3′) using the primers listed in the protocol. Use the following cycling conditions:

substeps.instruction: Initial denaturation: 98 °C, 30 s (1 cycle).
Denaturation: 98 °C, 10 s (12 cycles).
Annealing: start at 72 °C, decrease 1 °C per cycle, 20 s (12 cycles) reaching 60 °C.
Extension: 72 °C, 30 s (12 cycles).
Denaturation: 98 °C, 15 s (1 cycle).
Annealing: 60 °C, 15 s (28 cycles).
Extension: 72 °C, 30 s (28 cycles).
Final extension: 72 °C, 2 min (1 cycle).
Hold: 4 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Validate positive clones by Sanger sequencing
steps.instruction: Sequence PCR products (e.g., using the TH‑TdTomato Forward primer for the 5′ reaction) to confirm correct vector integration and Cre‑mediated excision.

steps.title: Expand colonies, freeze stocks, and karyotype
steps.instruction: Grow validated colonies, prepare multiple frozen stocks, and perform karyotype analysis. Use a fresh pipette tip for each well during media changes to avoid cross‑contamination.

steps.title: Backup freeze cells at recommended stages
steps.instruction: Freeze aliquots of cells at pre‑Cre, post‑Cre, and during expansion as backups; avoid unnecessary freeze‑thaw cycles.

description: Prepare the materials below for each section before starting the protocol. Refer to key resources table for a complete list of reagents and tools, and to materials and equipment for details on reagent preparation. Before you begin, review the key steps of the protocol using the flowchart in Figure S1.Note: All procedures are performed in a Class II biological hood with standard aseptic technique. Cells and midbrain organoids are cultured in a humidified 37°C incubator with 5% CO2.
